text:
alex: Quick sync for North Ridge POC - they want a tiny end-to-end demo that covers SDK init, streaming with ephemeral creds, function calls, and a structured output example. Also they asked for per-route latency and token usage during the trial.

maria_se: Who's doing SSO? They said enterprise SAML for admins and short-lived tokens for backend streams? Also confirm EU residency for prod.

alex: Correct - SAML for admin UI. Backend services will use ephemeral tokens to open websocket streams. EU required for prod, trial can be in US.

tim_infra: Ephemeral tokens we support via an STS-like POST. Short example we've shared before: 

```
POST /token
{ "grant_type":"client_assertion", "assertion":"<customer-signed-jwt>" }
# -> {"access_token":"ey..","expires_in":3600}
```

That token scopes to project and allowed routes. Works for streaming + function-calls. TTL can be configured (15m-1h).

ella_devex: SDK init snippet for the POC (Node) - minimal, supports streaming + tool calls. I'll put a tiny repo together: 

```
const Redwood = require('@redwood/sdk');
const client = new Redwood({ token: process.env.RW_TOKEN });
const stream = await client.stream('/converse', { model: 'redwood-lite' });
stream.on('data', (d) => console.log(JSON.stringify(d)));
```

Include sample function-call schema and structured JSON in the repo.

maria_se: Telemetry specifics they requested: per-route p50/p95, tokens per request, and websocket connection health (reconnects, drops). Can we show those on the trial tenant dashboard?

tim_infra: Yes for hosted trials we expose route-level latency & token counts in Console. For Dedicated/Private, we can forward metrics to their Datadog via OTLP/StatsD. Note: proxies/edge layers will inflate p95, call that out.

alex: Procurement wants a cost model for both pay-as-you-go and Dedicated reserved. They asked: "If we reserve for 99% latency SLO, what commit do we need?"

maria_se: For presales we give two paths: 1) hosted PAYG with projected monthly spend based on sample QPS, per-token + egress; 2) Dedicated reserved nodes - example offer: 2x A100 equiv -> baseline QPS X, with an introductory commit discount. I'll prepare a sample calc.

ella_devex: I'll draft a short runbook: SDK init, ephemeral token flow, example function-call payload, structured output schema, and a telemetry dashboard template. Will include quick troubleshooting steps for websocket auth failures. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

alex: Security questionnaire - KMS/customer-managed key, IP allowlist for websocket endpoints, SOC2 report. Can we answer now?

tim_infra: KMS: customer-managed keys supported for Private; for Hosted we support envelope encryption with customer-managed keys for enterprise tenants (we provide KMS integration). IP allowlist: supported for Dedicated and as tenant allowlist for hosted admin/control plane. SOC2: available under NDA.

maria_se: I'll respond to their security team with that wording and ask them to upload the questionnaire. Alex, want to cc Solutions Architect and Infra?

alex: Yes please cc @ella_devex and @tim_infra. Also share the mini repo and runbook with the engineering contact.

deploy-bot: Trial tenant created: nr-poc (https://console.redwood.ai/tenants/nr-poc). Telemetry view enabled.

alex: Great, thanks everyone. I'll follow up with procurement and ship the runbook once it's ready. :thumbsup:
